text: It does not seem as sturdy as some of the metal frames I have purchased .... So far it's working well for my 10 year old's full size box spring and mattress.  I dont know that I would trust it with a couple of large adults on it.  It does not seem as sturdy as some of the metal frames I have purchased at mattress stores.
